messages:
rachel (finance): Heads-up: starting 2026-11-01 were changing invoice granularity and token rounding rules to make bills more predictable. Key points below. Dry-run (telemetry-only) starts 2026-10-01.

jordi (product): Short explainer for customers: were consolidating token billing to per-minute aggregation (instead of per-request) and rounding to the nearest 10 tokens for exported usage. This reduces micro-charges from chatty integrations. No immediate cost savings guarantee.

amir (eng-billing): Implementation: new usage API fields: billing_granularity:minute and rounding_unit=10. We'll add header X-Redwood-Billing-Granularity: minute during dry-run. Feature flag: billing_rounding_v2. During October welog both old and new values in /v1/usage for comparison.

amir (eng-billing): Example: previously two requests of 7 and 9 tokens -> billed 16 tokens; with per-minute aggregation and rounding 7+9=16 -> round to 20. We'll document exact math in the playbook.

lina (support): CS note: prepare canned response: "We're switching invoicing aggregation to reduce noise from many tiny calls. During October you'll see a telemetry column showing rounded_tokens. No charges change until Nov 1." Also add triage steps: check X-Redwood-Billing-Granularity and rounding_unit in response.

jess (sales): For AEs: update renewal talking points — this is about predictability, not a discount. Add a short one-liner: "We're reducing invoice noise by aggregating usage and rounding to a 10-token granularity."

rachel (finance): Finance ops: CSV change: new columns rounded_tokens and rounding_unit. We'll keep old columns for 45 days in exports. Please run reconciliation scripts against the sample set in October and raise mismatches in #finance.

amir (eng-billing): Note: marketplace reseller flows may need adapter updates because some partners rely on per-request lines. We'll add a flag to emit per-request lines for partner accounts during migration.

bill-bot: usage export ready for tenant: beta-co - /exports/usage/2026-10-02/beta-co-usage.csv :white_check_mark:

lina (support): Requesting a short playbook snippet and an internal KB paragraph. I'll draft and submit for review.

jordi (product): Owners: eng (amir) feature flag and API headers; finance (rachel) CSV mapping and reconciliations; support (lina) canned replies; sales (jess) AE talking points. Timeline: dry-run 2026-10-01; go-live 2026-11-01.

rachel (finance): Risk note: some customers with strict per-request reconciliation may complain. Mitigation: 4-week notice, dual CSVs in October, and partner opt-out path.

jess (sales): I'll update AE templates today and share the customer-facing FAQ draft by EOD.

amir (eng-billing): Rolling out dry-run to staging now, will post logs in #eng-billing and tag owners when dual-values are available.

jordi (product): Thanks team. We'll post a short announcement to customers the week of 2026-10-10 and link to the KB. Ping me for questions.
